description: This file defines a Flutter widget 'ProductCard' which displays product information such as image, brand name, title, price, and discount details. It is used in an e-commerce UI to show individual product items.

classes.name: ProductCard
classes.description: A stateless widget that presents a product's image, name, price, and discount info in a styled card with clickable functionality.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the ProductCard, rendering product image, details, and discount badge.
